name: comp-308
blurb: Dark centered feature banner with icon, message, rounded button, and close.
description: Full-width dark-themed feature banner with eclipse icon, centered content, rounded Learn more button, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need a centered, minimal feature announcement with one prominent action.
avoid_when: For multi-action announcements; use comp-307 or comp-306 instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons are aria-hidden. Component uses useState to manage visibility.
